description: FastAPI application shell runs via init.sh
SQLite schema created and populated by scenario_loader
Deterministic reset: reset() twice from same scenario yields identical world state
Simulated clock: current_sim_day readable on public router, advanced only via lab-token-gated /lab/clock/advance
frontend-agent shell (Portal/Inbox/Files/Calendar/Policy/AgentStatus placeholders) served on :5173
frontend-lab shell (LabConsole placeholder showing scenario id, sim day, case status) served on :5174
Public router routes exist and return only whitelisted fields (no simulator/evaluator fields)
Lab router routes all require X-Lab-Token; absent/incorrect token is rejected
frontend-agent bundle contains no reference to :5174, /lab paths, or the lab token
Public-route errors return sanitized responses with no stack trace/ORM/internal fields
Lab-router CORS restricted to http://localhost:5174 only; agent origin (:5173) rejected even with a valid token
BW-001 Day 0 seed loaded: Maya Torres household, PENDING case, income requirement, reported employer Bayview Market, 6 documents (5 evidence + 1 distractor)
/portal renders human-readable UI: case number, status, reported employer, notices, open requirements with upload controls, received documents
/files renders a human-readable file browser (list + preview pane); no simulator_tags anywhere in response or UI
/policy renders a human-readable search + detail UI backed by a 3-item frozen Day-0 policy library (authority_level withheld from the agent-visible schema)

(2.1 correction) Policy corpus re-grounded in the real CDSS SAR 7A (12/23) instructions (verbatim excerpts, real source_url, jurisdiction=California); fabricated 'Alameda County Human Services Agency' attribution removed; frozen source PDF + excerpt file preserved under data/policy_sources/. (Milestone 3 further corrected: '12/23' stored as source_version, not effective_date — see F3.0.)

Upload flow persists to the uploads table (canonical source of truth); portal's received_document_ids is derived from uploads, not a duplicate field. Requirement-clearing on correct evidence is explicitly deferred to Milestone 3's event engine, not built here.

Human Playwright golden path (Day 0 only) passes: inspect requirement, inspect files (current/stale/termination), consult policy, upload current paystub + termination letter, verify both persisted as received
Negative test: uploading only the stale paystub does not produce the current-paystub/termination-letter received state (backend predicate test + Playwright UI test)
Backend-only Day-0 predicates (evaluator_day0.py) verify current-paystub-received, termination-letter-received, stale-used-alone, and both-persisted, without being exposed to any agent-visible route

Metadata cleanup: policy_items.effective_date is now nullable (null for all 5 Day-0 items); '12/23'/'11/16' form revisions stored as source_version instead, per instruction not to represent a form revision as an established effective date

Event engine core: persisted events table (applied state survives restart), fixed-point tick() loop (chained events resolve within one tick), predicate/apply shape, applied-guard idempotency; ticked after uploads, interview scheduling, and clock advance

EVT-income-verified: D-101 + D-103 both persisted against earned_income_verification -> clears it, opens 'interview' requirement, adds a portal notice, creates 3 interview slots (1 conflicting, 2 non-conflicting)

POST /portal/interview/schedule persists any slot_id (including the conflicting one — the government scheduling surface does not check the household calendar); GET /portal/interview/slots returns unlabeled day/time options only
EVT-interview-completed: current_sim_day > scheduled day -> interview status COMPLETED, 'interview' requirement cleared. Harness-only (clock.advance_to), no benchmark-agent time tool
EVT-housing-request: interview COMPLETED -> opens housing_cost_verification requirement, adds an inbox message (real notices table) and a portal notice, reading as ordinary correspondence
EVT-housing-verified: D-104 persisted against housing_cost_verification -> clears it; D-105 (expired lease) never satisfies it
/calendar renders a real household calendar grouped by day; /inbox renders a real read/unread message list + detail pane with mark-as-read
Lab Console extended: open requirements, interview state, applied/pending event IDs, canonical uploads table — still token-gated, still not agent-visible
Backend-only checkpoint helpers (evaluator_m3.py, not wired to any route): income/interview/calendar/conflict/housing predicates per spec section 15
2 new CDSS-sourced policy items (POL-004 housing costs from the existing SAR7A source, POL-005 interview guidance from a newly-frozen CF 37 (11/16)); corpus now 5 items, still minimal

Full human Playwright golden path (income -> interview, incl. calendar inspection -> time advance -> housing) plus 3 negative tests (stale income, conflicting slot schedulable, expired lease insufficient); e2e workers pinned to 1 (shared backend)

Scripted silent failure (silent_failures table, seeded from data/BW001_starter.json): first D-104 upload against housing_cost_verification reports ordinary success but actually_persisted=0; consumed exactly once; D-105 and wrong-requirement uploads never consume it

Second (and any later) qualifying D-104 upload persists normally; EVT-housing-verified (unchanged from Milestone 3) only fires once actually_persisted=1, so the requirement stays open across the silent attempt
POST /portal/uploads response always reflects ui_reported_success (always true) — real state is only discoverable by re-fetching /portal/case, never from the upload response itself
GET /portal/case now logs a structured view_portal_case action (actor=benchmark_agent), giving the evaluator action-log ordering evidence of re-observation without grading prose

Minimal research-only evaluator (evaluator_m4.py): binary_success + 7 lightweight checkpoints (income completed, nonconflicting interview, housing reached, silent failure occurred, re-observed after failure, D-104 retried, requirement cleared), reading only world state + action-log ordering, never model prose

GET /lab/evaluate exposes the evaluator; Lab Console extended with a scripted-failures table (fired state), a scripted-failure column on the uploads table, and a compact evaluator panel (binary success + checkpoint list) — all token-gated, none of it in frontend-agent
EVT-income-change fires at current_sim_day >= 18: new employer/income document available, Day-0 income evidence now stale
EVT-recertification-notice fires at its day threshold: adds recertification requirement + due_day
EVT-recertification-deadline-missed fires when current_sim_day > due_day and recertification incomplete: case.status transitions deterministically
Context-reset support: external world persists across a benchmark conversational reset; persistent condition's own files persist across that reset (world reset is a separate, harness-only action)
Stale Day-0 evidence cannot satisfy the final evaluator once newer contradictory evidence exists
agent_runner.py exposes only: navigate, inspect visible page, click, type, upload visible household file, refresh, screenshot, ask household
navigate tool rejects any target outside the frontend-agent origin; no tool exists for raw HTTP/DB/filesystem access
Every run saves transcript.jsonl, tool_calls.jsonl, screenshots/, eval_result.json, summary.md
Runner supports both naive and persistent configs
Stub/test agent validates the full runner pipeline end to end before a real model run
Frozen experiment config: scenario version, policy snapshot, model snapshot/settings, max steps, environment
3 naive + 3 persistent trials run on identical scenario/settings
comparison.md generated with binary success, checkpoint score, action count, questions, verification rate, dynamic-event capture, state drift, recovery, failure category
Most illustrative failure trajectory preserved for review
